description: Six-camera distributed-aperture rig: cube-face boresights, 100 deg square FOV pinhole cameras, notional ~30 m civil jet lever arms. Design (nominal) geometry.
body_frame: FRD (x forward, y right, z down), origin = Aircraft Reference Point (IMU)
camera_frame: OpenCV (x right, y down, z forward), origin = optical centre
R_body_cam_definition: v_body = R_body_cam @ v_cam; columns are the camera x, y, z axes expressed in BODY; stored row-major

image.pixel_convention: integer (u,v) = pixel centres; image spans [-0.5, W-0.5]

time_model.sync: all cameras exposed at the frame timestamp (WP-01)

installation_error_model_for_rig_true.rotation: R_body_cam_true = R_body_cam_nominal @ Exp(omega), omega in CAM frame, each component ~ N(0, 0.20 deg), clipped to +/-0.60 deg
installation_error_model_for_rig_true.lever_arm: lever_arm_true = lever_arm_nominal + delta, each component ~ N(0, 0.005 m), clipped to +/-0.015 m
installation_error_model_for_rig_true.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed); draw order: for cam in F,R,B,L,U,D: omega(3) then delta(3)

cameras.name: up
cameras.mount: fuselage top, looking up; image top = forward

cameras.name: down
cameras.mount: fuselage belly, looking down; image top = forward

coverage_check: Director check 2026-09-22 (400k random directions): every direction is inside >=1 camera FOV; 18.67% inside >=2; max 3 (cube corners).
